name: How long does panel molding installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does panel molding installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of panel molding installation depends on the project's scope, including the size of the area, the complexity of the chosen pattern, and whether any wall preparation is needed. A typical room with a straightforward design might take 1-3 days. More elaborate designs or multiple rooms will naturally require more time. During our initial consultation, we can provide a projected timeline once we assess the specific details of your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies with project scope, design complexity, and wall preparation, typically ranging from 1-3 days for a standard room.
